summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and the thin ignite handler adapters as specified. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py and monai/data/nifti_saver.py; plot function added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard handlers rewritten as delegating adapters; NIfTI writer default dtype changed to np.float32; output_path renamed to output_dir in two examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py; classification test passes filename. Added tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Nothing was run (per instructions): tests and flake8 are unverified. Line lengths, final newlines, and import cycles were checked by reading only. No commits made.
